Includes a spouse or civil partner, lineal ancestor or descendant, a business partner and certain persons connected via a trust

CGT relief where shares in a SEIS company are disposed of after being held for 3 years and certain criteria are met

note.summary: HS393 explains how to claim SEIS Income Tax relief and two SEIS CGT reliefs (reinvestment relief and disposal relief) for tax year 2025 to 2026, including eligibility conditions, how to enter claims on the SA101 Additional Information pages and box 19 of the main return, and rules on carrying back relief to the previous tax year. It sets out the £200,000 subscription limit and 50% relief rate for 2025 to 2026, joint ownership treatment, substantial interest and associate definitions, and conditions for claiming reinvestment relief on gains reinvested in qualifying SEIS shares.

4a87087b82d236d5.heading: Seed Enterprise Investment Scheme — Income Tax and Capital Gains Tax reliefs (Self Assessment helpsheet HS393) > 3\. Which SEIS shares qualify for reinvestment relief > 3\.1 How much reinvestment relief can you claim

amounts.name: Cap on reinvestment relief (50% of amount receiving SEIS Income Tax relief)
Maximum SEIS Income Tax relief claimable
Minimum holding period for disposal relief

caveats: Figures (£200,000 SEIS Income Tax relief cap, £100,000 reinvestment relief cap, £6,000 AEA) apply specifically to tax year 2025 to 2026 and may differ in other years.
Reinvestment relief must not exceed 50% of the amount on which SEIS Income Tax relief is received.

Disposal relief is not due, wholly or partly, if shares are disposed of within 3 years of issue (except disposals to spouse/civil partner), triggering withdrawal of Income Tax relief and CGT chargeability on any gain.
Only part of a gain may be exempt from CGT if Income Tax relief was partly withdrawn or subscriptions exceeded the maximum allowed.
If no Income Tax liability exists before the SEIS subscription, no Income Tax relief is received and any gain on disposal is fully chargeable.
The notes on form SEIS3 explain situations where relief must be withdrawn or reduced — not detailed in this chunk.

note.summary: This chunk explains how SEIS reinvestment relief is calculated and capped, how to claim it on the Capital Gains Tax summary (SA108) pages of the Self Assessment return, and the claim time limit. It also covers SEIS disposal relief conditions, when disposal relief is not due, how losses on SEIS share disposals are treated, and includes worked examples.
